findings.text: The docstring promises each row set once, but enumeration for `t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)` with `maxRows = 1` produces 17 candidates with only two distinct contents because rowid assignment replaces pool values. Fix: describe uniqueness of selected pool multisets before affinity conversion and rowid assignment.

The statement that only random databases have mixed-column rows is false: targeted and enumerated candidates for `t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, a)` include `[1, NULL]` without random sampling. Fix: describe uniform value selection before storage transformations and acknowledge that supplied rows and their variants can also have different column values.
